notes.title: Trading Cards & other Community Items added!
notes.content:
[p]Collectible community items for Metal Garden are now available!

This includes trading cards, badges, emoticons and profile backgrounds!

Trading cards should appear retroactively in your inventory if you've played the game in the past.


Thank you for your continued support of Metal Garden! <3[/p]

notes.title: VERSION 2.2.0 - French Localization & Auto Aim
notes.content:
- Added French localization.
French localization created by Daniel Schneider Ruhland.

- Added Auto Aim into the game.
It can be enabled from the Options Menu. When using it, player's weapons will automatically lock onto enemy nearest to the center of the screen.

- Added option to change Player Crosshair visibility.

- Pressing 'Interact' key during an Eavesdrop before the eavesdrop text has been completed will no longer skip to the next Eavesdrop section but just show the full current Eavesdrop line (consistent with how the rest of the dialogue works in the game).

- Fixed a bug where Warning sign icons around the 'Flatlined' text in the Game Over screen wouldn't show up.

- The message warning the player about receiving Neuro Damage at the end of story section set within deceased spy's memories is now localized into player's selected language.

- Improved numerous UI overflow issues in non-English languages.

notes.title: VERSION 2.1.2
notes.content:
VERSION 2.1.2 changes:


- Another Hotfix update - some of the rotating geometry still wouldn't rotate properly after the last hotfix, so I replaced all of the rotating geometry in the game with new versions.

- Fixed a bug where gamepad triggers couldn't be mapped to any input action.

- Fixed a bug where the first enemy encounter of chapter 4 (enemies gathered in the valley between the rotating arrays) wouldn't spawn sometimes.

notes.title: VERSION 2.1.1
notes.content:
[p]VERSION 2.1.1 changes:[/p][p][/p][p]Hotfix update - playing the game at more than 144 FPS seemed to break some pieces of rotating geometry (such as the massive drills players have to traverse in chapter 3), by suddenly and randomly changing the axis they rotate around. This essentially made it impossible to progress through the game at above than 144 FPS.
[/p][p]Fixed by replacing old rotation code with a new custom script for rotating geometry, so the game should be playable at high framerates now.[/p]

notes.title: VERSION 2.1.0 - Croatian Localization
notes.content:
VERSION 2.1.0 changes:

- Added Croatian localization (made by yours truly). 
More localizations to bigger languages coming in future updates.

- Max Framerate Limit Lock has been increased from 144 FPS to 1000 FPS (WARNING: very high framerates may introduce bugs I haven't found yet).

- Fixed a glitch where players could accidentally load into chapter 4 early by jumping on top of lockers at the end of the big puzzle section in chapter 3. This glitch got added when I added additional triggers for loading chapter 4 a few updates ago. Since it doesn't appear this glitch can be used for speedrunning exploits, I've elected to patch it out.

- Various fixes to navigating menus with a controller:
> Game Over screen is now navigable with a controller. (okay, it's really a testament to the game's lack of difficulty this didn't get reported until like last week lol)
> Closing any of the submenus in the Main Menu or in the Pause Menu using a controller will now focus controller on last selected item (ie. the one that was just closed), instead of the top item in the menu. So for example, if player just closed the options menu with a controller, their selection in the main menu will now remain on the 'options menu' button, rather than return to the 'continue' button at the top.
> 'Return to the main menu' button in the Credits screen will now no longer lose correct padding when navigating the screen with a controller.
> 'Return to the main menu' button in the Credits screen can no longer be pressed multiple times with a controller, which would cause the screen fade out animation to reset.

- Different framerates should no longer affect controller aim sensitivity.

- Added a console command ('gamepad_support') that lets players toggle native gamepad support in-game, in case they want to use a custom service to rebind controls (eg., Steam Input). I considered making this a setting in the options menu instead, but there's a possibility Steam Deck or controller-only players could lock themselves out of being able to intereact with the game, so it's a console command instead.

- Added a console command ('opening_skip') that lets players skip opening text crawl and immediatly jump into the part where their character is getting up from the chair at the start of the game. Requested for speedrunning purposes from players.

- Fixed a bug where, if player left a dialogue area, and then manually opened up log, the 'Leaving Dialogue Area' warning would still be displayed.

notes.title: VERSION 2.0.1
notes.content:
VERSION 2.0.1 changes:

- Enemy collisions used for checking damage have been replaced with physics meshes. This should result in performance increase when there are multiple enemies on screen at lower end machines.

- All of the text and UI elements in the game have been adjusted to prepare the game for localization.

- Aiming with a sniper rifle while using a controller will now lower down sensitivity, allowing you to aim more precisely.

- Fixed a bug that would cause Exploration Mode modifier to not get saved during a checkpoint.

- Size of 'Continue from last checkpoint' submenu has been increased. Due to smaller size of the submenu, if player had a lot of modifiers turned on, some of them would get cut off.

- Pressing 'Return to Main Menu' button in the Credits after the fade out animation has already started will no longer reset the fade out animation.

- Gamepad keybinds in the Options menu will now display icons for buttons, instead of full names of specific buttons.

- Fixed a bug in the Game Over screen, where the flatline progress-bar image wouldn't extend to the edge of the screen.

- Fixed several typos.

notes.title: Metal Garden - Animations and Audio Rework Update
notes.content:
[p]VERSION 2.0.0 changes:
[/p][p][b]- Added revised weapon animations and audio to all player weapons.[/b][/p][p][b](old animations and audio can still be enabled from the options menu!!!)

[/b][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/k6Az1rkkfk8"][/dynamiclink]
[/p][p]- Added ability to toggle HUD 'on' and 'off' while playing the game.[/p][p]Set to 'T' key by default.
[/p][p]- Tutorials in the 1st chapter will now get closed by pressing the 'Backspace' key instead of 'Escape' key, so that players don't accidentaly close the tutorials while trying to pause the game.
[/p][p]- Slightly optimized performance of enemy collisions - they shouldn't be looking for overlap events at every frame now, so the game might run slightly better at low end hardware.
[/p][p]- Made sniper rifle more accurate in hip-fire (20 -> 15), to make it a bit more usable when hipfiring with the Shoulder Injury.
[/p][p]- Slightly increased enemy damage and speed on Regular difficulty and above.
[/p][p]- Added an 'Additional Information' popup for some settings in the Options Menu that might not be understandable from their short descriptions.
[/p][p]- Autosaves now also save unlocked doors, so if you load a checkpoint in chapters 2, 4 or 5 you can now also go backwards into the previous chapter.
[/p][p]- Added 'Player Volume' control to Audio settings menu.
[/p][p]- Improved collision detection when un-crouching, which should help with players ocasionally clipping out of bounds when un-crouching in tight spaces.
[/p][p]- Fixed a bug that would let players unholster weapons on ladders.
[/p][p]- Fixed several typos.
[/p][p]- Added a console command to let players disable the Ladder Infinite Jump fix that was introduced in the 1.1.4 update (for speedrunning purposes).
[/p][p]- Added an actor beneath the entire game world that returns player to last safe location if they touch it. Essentially, if player falls out of map bounds, they will no longer fall indefinitely and be forced to restart chapter, but will return to the nearest safe place they were at when they fell out of bounds.[/p]

notes.title: VERSION 1.1.6
notes.content:
VERSION 1.1.6. changes:

- Fixed a bug where the Steam achievement for reading all secret logs would not trigger.

- Added an additional level of HUD visibility (limited HUD). You can now toggle between: 
1) Fully visible HUD
2) Limited HUD (doesn't show crosshair/health/ammo, but still shows dialogue and interaction prompts)
3) Fully hidden HUD

notes.title: VERSION 1.1.5
notes.content:
VERSION 1.1.5 changes:

- Since the momentum from giant rotating drills in chapter 3 can be used to skip all the way across the canyon into the chapter 4 area, chapter 4 will now load correctly if players manage to do that jump.

- Edited slightly the letter found inside the cave in chapter 4 for clarity.

- Increased interaction distance of the eavesdrop segment under the large bridge in chapter 2.

notes.title: VERSION 1.1.4
notes.content:
VERSION 1.1.4 changes:

- Player weapons will now automatically update their position on the screen when changing aspect ratios (so they won't be stuck beneath the bottom of the screen when playing in ultrawide anymore).

- Added support for additional ultrawide resolutions (21:9 and 32:9) in Windowed and Fullscreen modes.

- Solved infinite double jump glitch that would sometimes appear while on ladders.

- Fixed a visual bug in the Autosurgery Station Menu, where Torso Injury lock size didn't respond to the actual max health amount.

notes.title: VERSION 1.1.3
notes.content:
VERSION 1.1.3 changes:

- Crouch, sprint and aiming can now be changed between Toggle and Hold modes.

- Added 'Exploration Mode' modifier.

- Pistol and Sniper Rifle no longer have perfect accuracy when hip-firing.

- Increased headshot damage multiplier: 1.35x -> 1.45x (shotgun can now one-hit kill Merc enemy types with headshots from up close)

- Increased Pistol firerate when auto firing.

- Pistol damage amount change: 36 -> 34

- Slightly increased fire rate of ranged enemy type guns.

- Slightly increased melee enemy type walking speed.

- Water animals now deal less damage.

- Improved collision geometry of various meshes.

- Improved look of various meshes around the game that had clipping issues.

- Edited slightly the final terminal entry for clarity.

- Fixed a bug where holding down fire button after running out of bullets in magazine would play the empty mag 'ping' sound twice.

- The barricade at the end of chapter 1 now has accurate collision during the opening animation.

- Trash catchers in the puzzle in chapter 2 now have louder sounds and more accurate sound attenuation.

notes.title: VERSION 1.1.2
notes.content:
VERSION 1.1.2 changes:

- Fixed a bug where changing movement keys to keybinds that were already used elsewhere wouldn't let new keybinds be applied.

notes.title: VERSION 1.1.1
notes.content:
VERSION 1.1.1 changes:

- Adjusted weapon auto fire to better follow animations.

- Added Update History document into the game files.

notes.title: VERSION 1.1.0
notes.content:
[b]Changes to player character:[/b]

- Pistol damage amount: 20 -> 36

- Shotgun damage amount: 11.5 per pellet (7 pellets per shell) -> 15 per pellet (7 pellets per shell)

- Sniper damage amount: 100 -> 125

- Melee damage amount: 50 -> 85

- Grenade damage amount: 145 (at the center of explosion) -> 185 (at the center of explosion)

- Air control: 0.16 -> 0.45


[b]Changes to enemy characters:[/b]

- Guns enemy type (Merc) fighting walk speed increased: 350 -> 375

- Merc firerate increased: from between 1.5-4.0 seconds to 1.25-3.5 seconds for projectile gun, and from 2.0-5.0 seconds to 1.5-3.5 seconds for charge rifle

- Increased aim speed of Merc charge rifles: 3.0 -> 4.0

- Melee enemy type (Leo) fighting walk speed increased: 475 -> 575

- Leo health amount decreased: 225 -> 200

- Increased speed of enemy gun projectiles: 5000 -> 6000

- Increased speed of enemy charge rifle projectiles: 180000 -> 200000

- Greatly increased enemy hitboxes.

- Added extra force to enemy ragdolls.

- Headshot damage multiplier: 1.5x -> 1.35x

- Enemy regular gun projectiles damage increase: 11 -> 15

- Enemy charge rifle projectiles damage increase: 16 -> 20

- Border watcher health increase: 4250 -> 4700

- Border watcher stagger state length: 7 seconds -> 12 seconds

- Border watcher damage dealt to total health after core destruction: 1250 -> 1750


[b]Miscellaneous changes:[/b]

- All weapons can now be auto fired by holding the attack button.

- Several changes to the big puzzle section at the end of chapter 3: there are now more pipes that can be used to access the level with the second moving platform, and there is now a ladder that can be extended back to the beginning from the generator at about the halfway point of the puzzle.

- Auto surgery units now have 2 charges instead of 1 on Hard difficulty.

- When starting the game from a later chapter using the 'chapter select' menu option, players will now spawn with more ammo (more ammo further along the selected chapter is in the game).

- Added some extra pistol ammo in chapter 2, and extra sniper ammo in chapters 2, 3 and 4.

- Sprint will now also start if while a sprint key is held, one of the movement keys is pressed (before it would only start if one of the movement keys was already held when the sprint key was pressed).

- Sprint is now much 'stickier' on a controller - moving the left stick sideways will no longer disengage sprint.

- If Aim button is held during reload, weapon will now automatically go into aim-down-sights mode after the reload animation finishes.

- Added option in the game menu to toggle between requiring and not requiring reload when Infinite Ammo modifier is enabled.

- Added more respawn points after failing jumps, and made triggers of existing ones tighter.

- Slightly reworked enemy jumping navigation for the ruined cliffside house encounter in chapter 4. Enemies will now no longer jump onto the small piece of geometry near the start of the encounter that made them look like they were jumping into the chasm.

- Opening core hatch after defeating Border Watcher will now just show a disabled core, rather than not allowing you to open the hatch in the first place.

- Big cannons in the background that fire periodically are now a little bit less loud.

- Fixed some typos in the script.

- A warning will now pop up if player tries starting a chapter with the "Start with weapons and items that would've been acquired by this chapter?" option disabled, explaining that doing so can cause the player to get locked out of certain areas.

notes.title: VERSION 1.0.4
notes.content:
- Added support for inverted mouse look.

- Torso injury max health reduction has been changed from limiting player to 50% of health, to limiting player to 65% health.
Reason is that compared to other injuries, torso injury feels far harsher. It actively contributes to building towards other injuries much more than anything else in the game, very easily leading to players getting stuck with big injury stacks.

- Added slightly more sniper rifle ammo at the start of chapter 3.

- Slightly increased grenade damage amount.

- Slightly increased Rhea Secretorum's soldiers (the melee enemy type) walking speed.

- Tutorial tips in the first chapter will now automatically fade out after you progress past the opening area of the game.

- Fixed a bug where players could still interact with one of the levers in the big puzzle encounter at the end of chapter 3, even after it had been used.

- Made one of the pipes in the big puzzle encounter at the end of chapter 3 a bit larger to make it easier to grab onto.

- Removed two medpacks on Regular difficulty which were very close to multiple other medpacks in their levels.

- Movement speed of water animals is now no longer tied to framerate, and they deal less damage to player.

- The final boss's missile launchers now have less health.

- Interacting with the core hatch of the final boss after they've been defeated will now show a 'hatch is stuck' message.

- Fixed some visual bugs (incorrect textures on several meshes, clipping geometry).
